payload.credit_html: "Bicharracosaurus dionidei, gen. et sp. nov., a new macronarian (Dinosauria, Sauropoda) from the Late Jurassic Cañadón Calcáreo Formation of Argentina and the problematic early evolution of macronarians"
payload.description_html: Reconstruction of Bicharracosaurus dionidei (MPEF-PV 1730). Skeletal reconstruction showing preserved elements. Some ribs are depicted here as left elements for visual purposes. Image source credit: Silhouette based on Camarasaurus by Scott Hartman.
